title: HostProfileDocument
description: Professional host identity stored at hostProfiles/{uid}. This document is separate from users/{uid} dating profile data and publicProfiles/{uid}.
x-owner: owner direct write, callable seeded during host club operations

displayName.description: Professional display name for host, club, event, and support-chat surfaces.

avatarUrl.description: Professional host avatar or organization logo URL. Server-owned: organizer callables seed it from the host's own profile photo, and firestore.rules forbid the host from setting or changing it.

roleTitle.description: Professional title such as Founder, Coach, Organizer, or Community Lead.

bio.description: Professional host bio. Must not mirror dating-profile prompts.

verified.description: Server-owned verification flag. firestore.rules forbid the host from setting or changing it.

linkedOrganizerIds.description: Server-owned organizer links. firestore.rules forbid the host from setting or changing them; organizer membership lives on organizers/{organizerId}.
